configInvalidField.zh-CN: 安全规则配置字段无效：{field}

presetsRemoved.zh-CN: 配置里的 presets 字段已移除：预设功能已删除，请把规则直接写进 rules。原来 destructive-operations 的 4 条规则见 README 或 config.example.json，可整段复制到 rules 里。
presetsRemoved.en-US: The presets field was removed: presets no longer exist, so write rules directly under rules. The four rules that used to make up destructive-operations are in the README and config.example.json; copy them into rules.

detectorRemoved.zh-CN: detector 匹配器已移除：它把匹配逻辑藏在代码里。请改用显式匹配：commands（命令名）、commandPrefixes（命令名前缀）、commandPattern（原始命令文本正则），需要命令加参数组合判断时用 module。旧名字到新写法的对照见 README。
detectorRemoved.en-US: The detector matcher was removed because it hid matching logic in code. Use explicit matchers instead: commands (exact names), commandPrefixes (name prefixes), commandPattern (regex over the raw command text), or module when a matcher needs command-plus-argument logic. See the README for old-name to new-syntax mappings.

configLoadFailed.zh-CN: 安全规则加载失败，Bash 已阻断。请修复配置并 /reload：{error}
configLoadFailed.en-US: Safety rules failed to load; Bash is blocked. Fix the configuration and /reload: {error}

noRules.zh-CN: 尚未配置任何安全规则，本插件不会阻断操作。
noRules.en-US: No safety rules are configured; this extension will not block operations.

confirmTitle.zh-CN: 确认执行命中的危险操作？

confirmationUnavailable.zh-CN:
此操作需要用户确认，但当前模式无法交互，已阻断：
{details}
confirmationUnavailable.en-US:
User confirmation is required but this mode cannot prompt; operation blocked:
{details}

confirmationRejected.zh-CN:
用户未确认，操作已阻断：
{details}
confirmationRejected.en-US:
The user did not confirm; operation blocked:
{details}

warning.zh-CN:
安全规则提醒（本规则不阻断操作）：
{details}
warning.en-US:
Safety rule warning (operation was not blocked by this rule):
{details}

shellParseBlocked.zh-CN: 无法完整解析 Bash 命令，已阻止执行。
shellParseBlocked.en-US: The Bash command could not be parsed completely and was blocked.

ruleFailed.zh-CN: 安全规则 [{id}] 执行失败，已阻止操作：{error}

moduleMustExportMatcher.zh-CN: 规则模块必须默认导出匹配函数。
moduleMustExportMatcher.en-US: A rule module must default-export a matcher function.

matcherMustReturnBoolean.zh-CN: 规则匹配函数必须返回布尔值。
matcherMustReturnBoolean.en-US: A rule matcher must return a boolean.

moduleTimeout.zh-CN: 规则模块加载或匹配超时。
moduleTimeout.en-US: Rule module loading or matching timed out.

configCommandUsage.zh-CN: 用法：/config:safety-guards（显示配置文件路径和生效规则）或 /config:safety-guards show。改规则请直接编辑配置文件。
configCommandUsage.en-US: Usage: /config:safety-guards (shows the configuration file path and effective rules) or /config:safety-guards show. Edit the configuration file to change rules.

configSeedCreated.zh-CN: 首次运行：已把默认安全规则写入 {path}，可直接编辑这个文件增删规则。
configSeedCreated.en-US: First run: default safety rules were written to {path}; edit that file to add or remove rules.
